dyn.charity.other_international_activity.definition: Free-text description supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement of the 'other' international activities it undertook during the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim.
dyn.charity.other_international_activity.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds charity-owned free-text describing residual international activities; ext.entity.operating_country is a structured business-owned country value, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

dyn.charity.volunteer_count.definition: Number of volunteers the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own reporting period. A count of volunteers, distinct from paid staff headcount and from full-time-equivalent staff; a reported zero is retained as published.
dyn.charity.volunteer_count.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers volunteer numbers; dyn.charity.staff_headcount (proposed) covers paid staff by employment category, and volunteers are unpaid and reported in a separate column, so folding them in would change meaning.

ext.financial.total_income.definition: Total income as published for a stated reporting period. A fact for a period, not a current attribute.

dyn.charity.accounting_basis.definition: The accounting basis (Cash or Accrual) on which the charity prepared its reported financial information for the reporting period, as published by the ACNC. A reporting-basis classification, not a financial measure.
dyn.charity.accounting_basis.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept describes the accounting basis of reported financials; dyn.charity.financial_statement_type in this patch covers the statement framework, a different attribute.

dyn.charity.full_time_equivalent_staff.definition: Total full-time-equivalent staff the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own reporting period, expressed as an FTE number of persons (decimal, e.g. 4.14). This is a workload-equivalent measure, not a headcount and not a monetary amount.
dyn.charity.full_time_equivalent_staff.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds an FTE measure; dyn.charity.staff_headcount (proposed) counts people per employment category and cannot represent fractional FTE, so reuse would change units and meaning.

dyn.charity.international_activity_other.definition: Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity undertook other international activities not covered by the operating-overseas or goods/services-transfer categories during the reporting period, recorded as y/n.
dyn.charity.international_activity_other.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers a residual 'other international activities' flag for a charity; the existing operating-region/country concepts are business-owned location values, not y/n activity flags.

dyn.charity.staff_headcount.definition: Number of people the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement as staff of a given employment category (full time, part time or casual) for its own reporting period. A headcount of people, not full-time-equivalent staff and not a monetary amount; a reported zero is retained as published and is not evidence of no activity.
dyn.charity.staff_headcount.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records charity staff headcounts; ext.financial.total_income is a monetary business-owned measure and employee expenses is a money amount, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units. The three columns share one meaning (people per employment category) and differ only by category, so one concept with an employment_category qualifier avoids needless aliases.

dyn.charity.size_band.definition: The ACNC charity size classification (Small, Medium or Large) reported for the charity in its Annual Information Statement. This is a regulator reporting classification, not a measure of company scale, revenue band or legal form.
dyn.charity.size_band.why_not_existing: ext.financial.revenue_band is a revenue/turnover band from a named scheme owned by business; the ACNC size classification is a charity-role reporting category with its own thresholds and labels, so reuse would change meaning and owner.

dyn.charity.international_activity_trans.definition: Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity undertook international activities by transferring goods or services overseas during the reporting period, recorded as y/n.
source_paths: international activities undertaken - transferring goods or services overseas
dyn.charity.international_activity_trans.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept captures a charity's self-reported goods/services transfer overseas flag; ext.entity.operating_country is a country value owned by business, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

dyn.charity.financial_report_received_da.definition: The date on which the ACNC received the charity's financial report for the reporting period. A document lodgement receipt date, distinct from the AIS receipt date and from the report's period dates.
dyn.charity.financial_report_received_da.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers financial-report lodgement receipt; dyn.charity.ais_received_date in this patch refers to the AIS lodgement, a different document, so reuse would change meaning.

dyn.charity.international_activity_detai.definition: Free-text description supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement of the international activities it undertook during the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim; it does not by itself establish a country of operation.
dyn.charity.international_activity_detai.why_not_existing: ext.entity.operating_country is a single country value owned by business; this is charity-owned free-text narrative that may mention several places without being a structured country claim, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

dyn.charity.no_activity_reason.definition: Free-text explanation supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for why it did not conduct activities during the reporting period. Publisher wording is retained verbatim; it is self-reported narrative, not a regulator finding.
source_paths: why charity did not conduct activities
dyn.charity.no_activity_reason.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds charity self-reported narrative reasons for inactivity; ext.licence.authorisation_text is licence authorisation text owned by the licence role, so reuse would change meaning and owner.

dyn.charity.purposes_pursued_description.definition: Free-text description supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement of how it pursued its charitable purposes during the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim, not a regulator classification or an ANZSIC activity code.
dyn.charity.purposes_pursued_description.why_not_existing: ext.entity.sector_tag is a short source-stated tag with a scheme qualifier, not a full narrative description of how purposes were pursued; ext.entity.industry_code is a reviewed crosswalk code. Reuse would change meaning and granularity.

dyn.charity.financial_report_period_star.definition: The start date of the reporting period covered by the charity's financial report as lodged with the ACNC. Defines the period scope for the charity's financial figures; it is not a registration or licence start date.
dyn.charity.financial_report_period_star.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept captures a charity financial-reporting period boundary; ext.licence.start_date is a licence commencement owned by the licence role and entity.date_registered is a business registration date.

dyn.charity.financial_report_period_end.definition: The end date of the reporting period covered by the charity's financial report as lodged with the ACNC. Defines the period scope for the charity's financial figures; it is not a financial year-end attribute or a licence end date.
dyn.charity.financial_report_period_end.why_not_existing: ext.entity.financial_year_end is a recurring dd-Mon reporting-cycle attribute owned by business, not a specific period end date for a charity's lodged financial report; ext.licence.end_date belongs to the licence role.

dyn.charity.report_modification_flag.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity's financial report for the reporting period carries a modification (y/n). A report-quality indicator, not a registration or compliance status.
dyn.charity.report_modification_flag.why_not_existing: dyn.charity.registration_status is a regulator registration state; no shortlisted concept records whether a lodged financial report was modified.

dyn.charity.conducted_activities.definition: Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity conducted any activities during its reporting period, recorded as y/n. A 'n' answer is accompanied by a free-text reason in a separate field and is not evidence the charity is inactive or deregistered.
dyn.charity.conducted_activities.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records whether a charity conducted activities in its reporting period; dyn.charity.registration_status is a regulator status and ext.entity.sector_tag is an activity tag, so reuse would change meaning and owner.

dyn.charity.ais_received_date.definition: The date on which the ACNC received the charity's Annual Information Statement for the reporting year, as published in the AIS dataset. This is a lodgement receipt date, not the charity's establishment or registration date.
dyn.charity.ais_received_date.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records AIS lodgement receipt; entity.date_registered and ext.entity.date_established are business dates with different meaning, and ext.licence dates belong to the licence role.

ext.financial.taxable_income.definition: Taxable income for the period. Missing is not zero.

dyn.charity.international_activity_opera.definition: Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity undertook international activities by operating overseas including programs during the reporting period, recorded as y/n.
source_paths: international activities undertaken - operating overseas including programs
dyn.charity.international_activity_opera.why_not_existing: ext.entity.operating_region and ext.entity.operating_country describe where a business says it operates, not a charity's self-reported international-activity flag; reuse would change owner, meaning and units (region/country values versus y/n).

dyn.charity.ais_due_date.definition: The date by which the charity's Annual Information Statement for the reporting year is due to be lodged with the ACNC, as published in the AIS dataset. This is a regulatory lodgement deadline, not a licence or registration date.
dyn.charity.ais_due_date.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers ACNC AIS lodgement deadlines; ext.licence.start_date/end_date are licence validity dates owned by the licence role, and entity.date_registered is a business registration date, so reuse would change meaning and owner.

dyn.charity.report_consolidated_flag.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity's financial report is consolidated with more than one entity (y/n). A reporting-scope indicator, not evidence of group structure or ownership.
source_paths: report consolidated with more than one entity
dyn.charity.report_consolidated_flag.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records whether a charity's financial report is consolidated; entity types and relationships are out of scope here and this is a reporting attribute of the charity role.

ext.establishment.region.definition: Publisher's region (licensing region, metro/regional, employment services area).

ext.licence.end_date.definition: Publisher-stated end of the licence, not the end of the business or all its claims.

entity_types.business: The source's business/legal-person subject; legal form remains unknown unless stated.
entity_types.licence: An authorisation held by a business.
entity_types.establishment: A physical operating facility, separate from its operator.
entity_types.charity: A registered charity lodging an Annual Information Statement with the ACNC, identified by its ABN; its legal form is not inferred from its name.
entity_types.fundraising_authorisation: A state or territory fundraising registration/licence number held by a charity, evidenced by a fundraising number column for that jurisdiction.

HOLDS_FUNDRAISING_AUTHORISATION.definition: Charity holds a state or territory fundraising registration evidenced by a fundraising number column for that jurisdiction.

retrieval: Lexical shortlist only; reuse requires identical meaning, owner, units and scope. Missing candidates can be requested with a narrower task.
